newsitem.title: USA: Ford continues $1,000 rebate on '97 Taurus.
newsitem.headline: Ford continues $1,000 rebate on '97 Taurus.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Wednesday it is continuing a $1,000 retail incentive on the 1997 Taurus sedan through July 7 as part of a group of rebates on Ford and Lincoln-Mercury products through the spring selling season.

Ford is now offering a $1,000 rebate on 1998 Windstar minivans, up from $500 before. It also doubled the 1997 Mercury Villager minivan rebate to $2,000. Ford took that action because it does not have a 1998 Villager, and it wanted to keep the vehicle competitive with the 1998 version of its sister, the Ford Windstar, said company spokeswoman Joy Wolfe.
On the Mustang, which had a $500 rebate across the board, Ford is now offering $750 on coupe models and $1,500 for convertibles.
The Ford Probe coupe now has a national $800 rebate program, instead of various regional incentives.
In general, the range of annual percentage rates for loans remains the same, said Wolfe. She said the new incentive program amounts to about the same overall marketing costs as Ford had a year ago.
